known.article: The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater AVA"

blurb.text: An Oregon AVA inside the Walla Walla Valley and the wider Columbia Valley, defined by its soil: an alluvial fan covered in baseball-sized basalt cobbles. It is described as the only US AVA whose boundaries follow soil type, and its wines are said to get unique flavors from the volcanic rocks.
